title: MySQL 8.4 — Query Performance
description: Answers which normalized statement digests consume time, exhibit tail latency, create disk temporary tables, miss indexes or return errors. Digest hashes are retained; literal SQL text is never exported.

query.query: MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId != 'verify-probe' | summarize by TargetId | order by TargetId asc

panels.title: Worst current p95
panels.description: Maximum latest p95 across bounded statement digests for each Target.

targets.query:
let samples = materialize(MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.statement_digest' and Field == 'latency_p95_ms');
let latest_by_target = samples | summarize LatestTimestamp=max(Timestamp) by TargetId;
samples
| join kind=inner latest_by_target on TargetId
| where Timestamp == LatestTimestamp
| summarize WorstP95Ms=max(Value) by TargetId

panels.title: Worst current p99
panels.description: Maximum latest p99 across bounded statement digests for each Target.

targets.query:
let samples = materialize(MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.statement_digest' and Field == 'latency_p99_ms');
let latest_by_target = samples | summarize LatestTimestamp=max(Timestamp) by TargetId;
samples
| join kind=inner latest_by_target on TargetId
| where Timestamp == LatestTimestamp
| summarize WorstP99Ms=max(Value) by TargetId

MetricSeriesRate('mysql.statement_digest', 'errors_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| summarize ErrorsPerSecond=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, ErrorsPerSecond) by TargetId
| project TargetId, ErrorsPerSecond

MetricSeriesRate('mysql.statement_digest', 'no_index_used_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| summarize NoIndexPerSecond=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, NoIndexPerSecond) by TargetId
| project TargetId, NoIndexPerSecond

panels.title: Top statement digests
panels.description: Latest cumulative workload and tail latency by normalized digest. SQL text is deliberately absent.

targets.query:
let samples = materialize(MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.statement_digest');
let latest_by_target = samples | summarize LatestTimestamp=max(Timestamp) by TargetId;
samples
| join kind=inner latest_by_target on TargetId
| where Timestamp == LatestTimestamp
| extend Schema=tostring(Tags.schema), Digest=tostring(Tags.digest)
| summarize Executions=maxif(Value, Field == 'executions_total'), P95Ms=maxif(Value, Field == 'latency_p95_ms'), P99Ms=maxif(Value, Field == 'latency_p99_ms'), Errors=maxif(Value, Field == 'errors_total'), RowsExamined=maxif(Value, Field == 'rows_examined_total') by TargetId, Schema, Digest
| order by P99Ms desc
| take 100

panels.title: Query tail latency
panels.description: Worst p95 and p99 among the top-K digest set at each collection timestamp.

targets.query:
MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.statement_digest' and Field in ('latency_p95_ms', 'latency_p99_ms')
| summarize LatencyMs=max(Value) by Timestamp, TargetId, Field
| extend Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Field)
| project Timestamp, Series, LatencyMs
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Temporary tables and no-index executions
panels.description: Rates derived independently per digest, then summed. Disk temporary tables are storage-sensitive; no-index executions indicate access-path regressions.

targets.query:
union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.statement_digest', 'tmp_disk_tables_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.statement_digest', 'no_index_used_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo))
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| summarize Rate=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId, Field
| extend Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Field)
| project Timestamp, Series, Rate
| order by Timestamp asc
